title: Compatible parameters and Artinian coefficient solution on the standardizer
statement: Let k be a field of characteristic p>0, A a finitely presented commutative k-algebra, Λ a Noetherian geometrically regular commutative k-algebra, α:A→Λ a k-algebra map, q a prime of Λ and N>0 with m_(Λ_q)^N contained in the extension to Λ_q of α(singularIdeal k A). Let d be the minimal number spanFinrank of generators of m_(Λ_q). Fix a finite generating family a_j of singularIdeal k A, S=k[x_0,...,x_(d-1)], a commutative algebra B in Type(max u v) with compatible k,A,S structures, and an A-presentation P on x_i,z_ij with exactly the relations x_i^(2N)-sum_j z_ij a_j and with the x_i the images of the variables of S. Let c>0. Then there are R=k[y_0,...,y_(m-1)], compatible S→R→Λ and k-structures, an S-algebra map η:B→Λ restricting to α on A, and π:Fin(d+1)→R. Each π_i is zero or the image under S→R of some X_j^c, maps into q, and multiplication by π_i and π_i² has identical kernels on both R/(π_j^8:j<i) and Λ/(image(π_j)^8:j<i). Put J=(π_i^8), Q=R_(q∩R) and L=Λ_q with its induced Q-algebra. There exist n>0, ideals I₀⊂R,K⊂L with m_L^n⊆JL, I₀Q⊆JQ, K⊆JL and I₀L⊆K. There exist t, a local Artinian commutative D′ in Type(max u v), and E=D′[T_0,...,T_(t-1)] with compatible R,R/I₀,S structures, essentially smooth over R/I₀, an S-algebra map θ:B→E and an R-algebra map b:E→L/K whose composite bθ is B→Λ→L→L/K. No improved presentation C₀ or factorization of its base change is asserted. All notions are those of the cited statement dependencies.

source.place: Lemma 07FJ, items item-NP through item-choose-deltai, item-set-map-R, item-sixth-resolve, item-eighth-resolve, item-done

proof.text: Geometric regularity makes L=Λ_q regular local, so d=spanFinrank(m_L)=dim L. Put e=8c and n=N+de. Apply 07FH to the images of finite algebra generators of A in L/m_L^n. This yields a polynomial map k[y]→Λ, prime p, a flat local P₀=k[y]_p→L with pL=m_L, and an essentially smooth local Artinian solution D₀ over P₀/p^n flat locally over L/m_L^n. Faithful flatness makes its map injective; therefore A maps into D₀. The flat height formula gives dim P₀=d; choose u_i in p giving parameters in P₀ and L.

Put R=k[y,t_0,...,t_(d-1)] and send X_i in S to u_i t_i. Permutations of the parameters are regular in P₀, so the u_i t_i form a regular sequence after inverting k[y] outside p. Successively apply regular-sequence powers and Ogoma on R/((u_jt_j)^e:j<i), multiplying u_i by elements outside p, to equalize the first and square kernels. Earlier equalities are unchanged and parameter generation is preserved.

Inductively construct δ_i outside q and λ_ij in Λ inside an enlarged Artinian coefficient solution D′. Faithful-flat contraction writes u_i^N=sum a_j d_j in D′. Lift d_j into L and correct the error in m_L^(n-N), then multiply by u_i^N so u_i^(2N)=sum a_j w_j with the prescribed residue classes. Choose a common denominator s₀ with w_j=u_j/s₀, and s₁ outside q killing s₀u_i^(2N)-sum u_j a_j. Set s=s₀s₁ and μ_j=s^(2N-1)s₁u_j: then (su_i)^(2N)=sum μ_j a_j and μ_j/s^(2N)=w_j. Enlarge by 07FI to include a positive power of s, rescaling μ_j. Apply Ogoma on Λ/((δ_ju_j)^e:j<i) and enlarge again by 07FI to include a suitable power (s′)^q. Take δ_i=(s′)^q s and λ_ij=(s′)^(2Nq)μ_j. This gives the relation in Λ, equal first/square kernels, and coefficient membership, preserving earlier conditions.

Map R to Λ by t_i→δ_i. The displayed presentation P defines η:B→Λ over S, using α on A, x_i→δ_i u_i and z_ij→λ_ij. Set I₀=p^nR and K=m_L^n. In Q=R_(q∩R), the t_i are units. The pigeonhole bounds m_L^(d(e-1)+1)⊆(u_i^e)L and p^(d(e-1)+1)Q⊆(u_i^e)Q show I₀Q⊆JQ, K⊆JL and m_L^n⊆JL, because n=N+de>0. The equality pL=m_L gives I₀L⊆K.

Set E=D′[t]. The map R/I₀→(P₀/p^n)[t] is localization, hence essentially smooth. Base change and composition make E essentially smooth over R/I₀. Use P to define θ:B→E: send A to D′, x_i to u_i t_i, and z_ij to bar(λ_ij)t_i^(2N)bar(δ_i)^(-2N). The bar(δ_i) are units by locality of D′→L/K. After factoring t_i^(2N), each relation is zero because the faithfully flat coefficient map is injective and (δ_i u_i)^(2N)=sum a_j λ_ij. Evaluation at δ_i followed by D′→L/K defines b:E→L/K. The two composites agree on A and on every generator of P, hence on B. This step constructs maps on B only, with no improved presentation or tensor factorization.

Take the parameter list (u_it_i)^c and append zero. Equality of the first and second kernels implies by induction that every positive power has the same kernel; this gives both required kernel conditions for the c-th powers, whose eighth powers are (u_it_i)^e. The appended zero leaves J unchanged and satisfies both conditions. When d=0, m_L=0 and n=N>0, so all containments still hold. Finite polynomial presentations of the smooth models for D′, followed by transporting their multiplicative subsets and localizing, give D′ in Type(max u v). Reindex the finite y,t variable set as Fin m, transporting structures, ideals and maps.

theorem exists_popescu_parameter_solution
    {k : Type u} {A : Type v} {Λ : Type w}
    [Field k] [CommRing A] [CommRing Λ] [Algebra k A] [Algebra k Λ]
    [FinitePresentation k A] [IsNoetherianRing Λ]
    (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] (hp : 0 < p)
    (α : A →ₐ[k] Λ) (q : PrimeSpectrum Λ)
    (hreg : IsGeometricallyRegular k Λ)
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (hpower : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal) ^ N ≤
      (Ideal.map α.toRingHom (singularIdeal k A)).map
        (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal)))
    (d : ℕ) (hd : d =
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal)).spanFinrank)
    (s : ℕ) (a : Fin s → A) (ha : Ideal.span (Set.range a) = singularIdeal k A)
    (B : Type (max u v)) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra A B]
    [IsScalarTower k A B] [Algebra (MvPolynomial (Fin d) k) B]
    [IsScalarTower k (MvPolynomial (Fin d) k) B]
    (P : Presentation A B (Fin d ⊕ (Fin d × Fin s)) (Fin d))
    (hval : ∀ i, P.val (Sum.inl i) =
      algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin d) k) B (MvPolynomial.X i))
    (hrel : ∀ i, P.relation i =
      (MvPolynomial.X (Sum.inl i) ^ (2 * N) -
        ∑ j : Fin s, MvPolynomial.X (Sum.inr (i, j)) * MvPolynomial.C (a j) :
          MvPolynomial (Fin d ⊕ (Fin d × Fin s)) A))
    (c : ℕ) (hc : 0 < c) :
    let S := MvPolynomial (Fin d) k
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (_ : Algebra (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) Λ)
      (_ : IsScalarTower k (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) Λ)
      (_ : Algebra S (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k))
      (_ : IsScalarTower k S (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k))
      (_ : Algebra S Λ) (_ : IsScalarTower S (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) Λ)
      (_ : IsScalarTower k S Λ)
      (η : B →ₐ[S] Λ) (π : Fin (d + 1) → MvPolynomial (Fin m) k),
      (η.restrictScalars k).comp (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k A B) = α ∧
      (∀ i, π i = 0 ∨ ∃ j : Fin d,
        π i = algebraMap S (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) (MvPolynomial.X j ^ c)) ∧
      (∀ i, algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) Λ (π i) ∈ q.asIdeal) ∧
      (∀ (i : Fin (d + 1))
        (x : MvPolynomial (Fin m) k ⧸ Ideal.span
          {y | ∃ j : Fin (d + 1), j.val < i.val ∧ y = π j ^ 8}),
        π i • x = 0 ↔ π i ^ 2 • x = 0) ∧
      (∀ (i : Fin (d + 1))
        (x : Λ ⧸ Ideal.span
          {y | ∃ j : Fin (d + 1), j.val < i.val ∧
            y = algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) Λ (π j) ^ 8}),
        π i • x = 0 ↔ π i ^ 2 • x = 0) ∧
    let R := MvPolynomial (Fin m) k
    let J := Ideal.span (Set.range (fun i : Fin (d + 1) ↦ π i ^ 8))
    let Q := Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.under R)
    let L := Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal
    letI := Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver (q.asIdeal.under R) q.asIdeal
    let JQ := J.map (algebraMap R Q)
    let JL := (J.map (algebraMap R Λ)).map (algebraMap Λ L)
    ∃ (n : ℕ), 0 < n ∧ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal L ^ n ≤ JL ∧
      ∃ (I₀ : Ideal R) (K : Ideal L),
        I₀.map (algebraMap R Q) ≤ JQ ∧ K ≤ JL ∧
        (I₀.map (algebraMap R Q)).map (algebraMap Q L) ≤ K ∧
        ∃ (t : ℕ) (D' : Type (max u v)) (_ : CommRing D')
          (_ : IsLocalRing D') (_ : IsArtinianRing D'),
          let E := MvPolynomial (Fin t) D'
          ∃ (_ : Algebra R E) (_ : Algebra (R ⧸ I₀) E)
            (_ : IsScalarTower R (R ⧸ I₀) E)
            (_ : Algebra S E) (_ : IsScalarTower S R E),
            EssentiallySmooth (R ⧸ I₀) E ∧
            ∃ (θ : B →ₐ[S] E) (b : E →ₐ[R] L ⧸ K),
              (b.restrictScalars S).comp θ =
                ((Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R K).restrictScalars S).comp
                  ((IsScalarTower.toAlgHom S Λ L).comp η)
